title: Press and hold the map on your phone
summary: Holding a finger on the map opens a wheel of quick actions at that spot.
items: Press and hold the map for half a second to open the map actions wheel; moving your finger still pans and drags tokens.
DMs get Encounter, Creatures, Characters, Place party, Move party, Ping, Reveal and More; holding a token gives its own wheel.
Slide onto an action and let go, or lift and tap. More lists every map action in a sheet.
Players get Place me, Ping, Measure and My sheet.
Map actions in the map tools opens the same actions without a long press.
